title: Composition law for prescribed etale Cech coefficient maps
statement:
Let $I$ be a preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ any diagram, and $c$ any cone with point $X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For a scheme map $q$ write $B_q$ for etale base change and $q^*$ for inverse image on abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $F_i$ and $\varphi_a:p_a^*F_i\to F_j$ be a coefficient system with the canonical identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\mathrm{Ab}(X_{et})$ have isomorphisms $e_{G,i}:G_i\simeq\pi_i^*F_i$ and maps $G(a)=e_{G,i};\chi;\pi_j^*(\varphi_a);e_{G,j}^{-1}$ for the canonical inverse-image comparison $\chi$. Let $L$ be any cocone on $G$ and $H=L.pt$, with legs $\lambda_i$. Fix $i_0$, a finite set $K$, etale objects $U_0,V_{0,k}$ over $D_{i_0}$ and $U,V_k$ over $X$, arrows $f_{0,k}$ and $f_k$ into their respective targets, and isomorphisms $e_U:B_{\pi_{i_0}}U_0\simeq U$, $e_{V,k}:B_{\pi_{i_0}}V_{0,k}\simeq V_k$ satisfying $B_{\pi_{i_0}}f_{0,k};e_U=e_{V,k};f_k$. These are fixed input data, without any covering or qcqs assumption. For $J=\{j\mid i_0\leq j\}$ take the actual pullback families $U_j,V_{j,k},f_{j,k}$. For $n\geq0$, $t:\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)\to K$, form $W_0(n,t)=\prod_{a=0}^n V_{0,t(a)}$ over $U_0$ with projections $r_{0,a}$, its pullbacks $W_j,W_X$, and the products $N_j,N_X$ of the stage and limit families [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex, def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-category-fibre-product]. Suppose given isomorphisms $z_j:W_j\simeq N_j$, $z_X:W_X\simeq N_X$ with projection identities $z_j;r_{j,a}=B_{p_{ji_0}}r_{0,a}$ and $z_X;r_{X,a}=B_{\pi_{i_0}}r_{0,a};e_{V,t(a)}$. Suppose also given $\gamma_a:B_{p_a}W_j\simeq W_k$ and $\delta_j:B_{\pi_j}W_j\simeq W_X$ whose first projections to $W_0$ equal the composites of the two pullback first projections. All these isomorphisms and identities are assumed for every degree and tuple. Put $C_j=\check C(f_j,F_j)$ and $C_X=\check C(f,H)$, and write $p_{j,n,t}$ and $p_{X,n,t}$ for the tuple projections from their degree $n$ terms. The prescribed transition equation is
$$m_{a,n};p_{k,n,t};F_k(z_k)=p_{j,n,t};F_j(z_j);\eta_{p_a,F_j}(W_j);\varphi_a(B_{p_a}W_j);F_k(\gamma_a^{-1}),$$
and the prescribed leg equation is
$$l_{j,n};p_{X,n,t};H(z_X)=p_{j,n,t};F_j(z_j);\eta_{\pi_j,F_j}(W_j);e_{G,j}^{-1}(B_{\pi_j}W_j);\lambda_j(B_{\pi_j}W_j);H(\delta_j^{-1}).$$
The presheaf images in these formulas are contravariant, so $F_j(z_j)$ denotes $F_j(z_j^{op})$. Suppose cochain maps $m_a:C_j\to C_k$ and $l_j:C_j\to C_X$ are given, whose degreewise components satisfy these two equations. Then $m_{a;b}=m_a;m_b$ for every composable pair. No identity or leg equation is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Apply cochain-map extensionality degreewise, then product extensionality to the target tuple projections. The target isomorphism z has an invertible presheaf image, so it can be cancelled in every component calculation.

Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext degreewise and Pi.hom_ext at each tuple. Postcompose with the invertible presheaf image of eNj r n t. For m(a) followed by m(b), substitute the component equation for b, reassociate, then substitute that for a. The intermediate restriction along eNj k cancels. Naturality of the unit and of φ b moves restriction along gamma a past these transformations. Substitute hcomposition for φ(a ≫ b), and use upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app evaluated at Wj j n t to replace the two successive units by the unit of the composite followed by the inverse-image composition comparison. The geometric comparison for the composite is the canonical iterated-pullback comparison followed by the pullback of gamma a and then gamma b. It equals gamma (a ≫ b): hγ for a and b gives the first projection to W0, which equals that for the composite by hγ and D.map_comp; the structural projections agree because all maps are in the etale over-category. The universal property of the pullback Wj r identifies the two maps. Contravariant functoriality now turns the combined restrictions into restriction along the inverse of gamma (a ≫ b). The resulting expression is exactly the prescribed component equation for m(a ≫ b). Cancel the target isomorphism and finish by extensionality. With empty K all tuple checks are vacuous. No leg law is asserted.

theorem etale_limit_finite_cech_coefficient_composition
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    (U : c.pt.Etale)
    (K : Type (u + 1)) [Finite K] (V : K → c.pt.Etale) (f : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U)
    (i₀ : I) (U₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (V₀ : K → (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) (f₀ : ∀ k, V₀ k ⟶ U₀)
    (eU : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj U₀ ≅ U)
    (eV : ∀ k,
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj (V₀ k) ≅ V k)
    (he : ∀ k,
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).map (f₀ k) ≫
        eU.hom = (eV k).hom ≫ f k) :
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let B := fun j : J ↦
      MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)
    let Blim := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))
    let Uj := fun j : J ↦ (B j).obj U₀
    let Vj := fun (j : J) (k : K) ↦ (B j).obj (V₀ k)
    let fj := fun (j : J) (k : K) ↦ (B j).map (f₀ k)
    let W₀ := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦
      (∏ᶜ fun a ↦ Over.mk (f₀ (t a))).left
    let pr₀ := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) (a : Fin (n + 1)) ↦
      (Pi.π (fun a ↦ Over.mk (f₀ (t a))) a).left
    let Wj := fun (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦ (B j).obj (W₀ n t)
    let Wlim := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦ Blim.obj (W₀ n t)
    let Nj := fun (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦
      (∏ᶜ fun a ↦ Over.mk (fj j (t a))).left
    let Nlim := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦
      (∏ᶜ fun a ↦ Over.mk (f (t a))).left
    let Pj := fun (j : J) (n : ℕ) ↦
      fun t : Fin (n + 1) → K ↦ (F j.val).obj.obj (op (Nj j n t))
    let Plim := fun (n : ℕ) ↦
      fun t : Fin (n + 1) → K ↦ L.pt.obj.obj (op (Nlim n t))
    let Cj := fun j : J ↦
      (cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (fj j k))).obj
        ((Over.forget (Uj j)).op ⋙ (F j.val).obj)
    let CX := (cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (f k))).obj
      ((Over.forget U).op ⋙ L.pt.obj)
    ∀ (eNj : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        Wj j n t ≅ Nj j n t)
      (eNlim : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K), Wlim n t ≅ Nlim n t)
      (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Wj j n t) ≅ Wj k n t)
      (δ : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Wj j n t) ≅ Wlim n t)
      (hNj : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) (a : Fin (n + 1)),
        (eNj j n t).hom ≫ (Pi.π (fun a ↦ Over.mk (fj j (t a))) a).left =
          (B j).map (pr₀ n t a))
      (hNlim : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) (a : Fin (n + 1)),
        (eNlim n t).hom ≫ (Pi.π (fun a ↦ Over.mk (f (t a))) a).left =
          Blim.map (pr₀ n t a) ≫ (eV (t a)).hom)
      (hγ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (γ j k a n t).hom.left ≫
            pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Wj j n t).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op))
      (hδ : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (δ j n t).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Wj j n t).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)),
      ∀ (m : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), Cj j ⟶ Cj k)
        (l : ∀ j : J, Cj j ⟶ CX),
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (m j k a).f n ≫
            Pi.π (Pj k n) t ≫ (F k.val).obj.map (eNj k n t).hom.op =
          Pi.π (Pj j n) t ≫ (F j.val).obj.map (eNj j n t).hom.op ≫
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app
                (op (Wj j n t)) ≫
            (φ (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a)).hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Wj j n t))) ≫
            (F k.val).obj.map (γ j k a n t).inv.op) ∧
      (∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (l j).f n ≫
            Pi.π (Plim n) t ≫ L.pt.obj.map (eNlim n t).hom.op =
          Pi.π (Pj j n) t ≫ (F j.val).obj.map (eNj j n t).hom.op ≫
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (c.π.app (op j.val))).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Wj j n t)) ≫
            (eG j.val).inv.hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Wj j n t))) ≫
            (L.ι.app j.val).hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Wj j n t))) ≫
            L.pt.obj.map (δ j n t).inv.op) →
      (∀ (j k r : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ r),
        m j r (a ≫ b) = m j k a ≫ m k r b)
